name: com.datasparc/dbhawk
description: Secure access to DBHawk datasources: browse schemas, run governed queries, HawkAI text-to-SQL.

environmentVariables.name: DBHAWK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: DBHawk base URL, e.g. https://dbhawk.example.com (no trailing /api)

environmentVariables.name: DBHAWK_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: MCP-scoped personal token (dbh_...) from DBHawk User Profile > API Token

environmentVariables.name: DBHAWK_DEFAULT_DATASOURCE
environmentVariables.description: Datasource used when a request doesn't name one
